name: Cabalen Cubing Fest 2025
information: Cabalen Cubing Fest 2025 marks the first-ever WCA-sanctioned competition organized by the [Cabalen Cubers Club](https://www.facebook.com/CabalenCubersClub). This milestone event brings together cubers from across the nation, proudly highlighting the growing cubing community in Pampanga. Participants will compete in officially recognized events, celebrating skill, speed, and community spirit in the heart of Pampanga.
